scope: Mac GPU Auto fitting resolves the source only when new provisional work is needed, preserving native decode/quality identity and cancellation
changes: Ready immutable native artifacts install without resolving the RAW URL through the source actor.
A completed provisional GPU fit and a matching pending native request reuse their owned state on slider ticks: no redundant URL resolution, fit call or duplicate-request generation await.
Actual cold/replacement fits retain the staged source and security scope until their joined return; stale source resumes are rejected before fitting.
A new decode or native quality still replaces the request. Actual fit completion is followed by generation/cancellation checks before starting cold native preparation.
Failed and valid-absent native results keep their prior distinctions; failed same-key preparation is not retried on every tick.
All existing pre-upload, pre-film, pre-submit and confirmed-publication guards remain. No color math, fit-quality policy, task priority, pool, Rust/WGSL/ABI/XMP/model or threshold changes.
sourceNote: Production files are unchanged after the 46-test run, full2037-test suite, Mac build and performance run. The test-only gate then gained an exact provider count and support for multiple erroneous waiters so failures cannot hang; all seven final-source preparation tests pass.
regressions: A real provisional GPU fit can continue while a gated native source download remains pending; only one actual provider invocation is allowed.
Replacing decode, then native quality on the same decode, cancels older waiters and publishes only the correct final negative result after the provider is released.
A source held across newer actor admission cannot mutate provisional fit state or start a native request when it resumes.
